text:
No deforestation event of 0.5 hectares or more was detected on the asset between 2021 and 2025. Observations covered the entire property.

The data did show 0.4 hectares of tree-cover loss in patches smaller than 0.5 hectares in 2021; these were below the event threshold. Smaller or narrow changes may also have been missed. This finding does not establish regulatory compliance or that no tree-cover change occurred.
